alpha = k / log_sum
print(f"\nHill estimator alpha = {k} / {log_sum:.6f} = {alpha:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 3 decimal places: {round(alpha, 3)}")

# Also compute alpha using the alternative form: alpha = k / (sum of log ratios)

print(f"\nFinal answer (rounded to 3 decimal places): {round(alpha, 3)}")
